title: World-Calibrated Proposal-to-Action Flow for Vision-Language-Action Models
description:
arXiv:2610.02323v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks by transporting samples from a task-agnostic isotropic Gaussian source. As this source is conditioned on neither recent execution nor predicted future evolution, (i) it discards the local continuity established by recently executed motion.
